mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle, compressing discount rates on equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in UNRATE above 3.0% triggers positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, reflecting improved labor market confidence and investor optimism.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises >0.3 percentage points in a month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when UNRATE crosses the 3.0% threshold, or the signal occurs outside the labor market recovery regime.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) and monthly housing demand (HOUST) signals robust economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The proxies move in opposite directions or the 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) despite the interaction.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 2.0% amplifies accommodative monetary policy, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The regime is not late-cycle expansion, or the FEDFUNDS rate does not decline below 2.0% in the period, or 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the monthly supply index (INDPRO) over three months signals robust production growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO does not trend upward over three months, or 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly GDP growth exceeding 18,500 (from current 18,671.497) triggers positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, reflecting strong economic momentum.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 exceeds 18,500 in the next quarterly period
failure_condition: GDPC1 does not exceed 18,500 in the next quarter, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) and monthly retail sales (RSAFS) signals robust demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The proxies move in opposite directions or the 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) despite the interaction.

mechanism_narrative: During a labor market recovery regime, a monthly UNRATE below 2.0% signals improving labor conditions, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The regime is not labor market recovery, or UNRATE does not fall below 2.0% in a month, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).
